description.value: Angry Otter Liquor is a retail liquor store operating under the Otter Co-op banner on Tranquille Road in Kamloops. As a co-operative, it is locally owned and community-focused. Cyclists passing through the North Shore area of Kamloops could stop here to resupply beverages for the road.
